name: Lucky7! - Join the Club!
source:
So... I guess here is where I should describe our matter...

Hi there! I´m Takashi! I assist Rainbow Hill High School! Yes, the one where the myth comes from, and no, we don´t actually see any rainbows from this place...

Anyway! I´m actually having a problem... with my friends... we are all having a problem...  You see... we are looking for a new member.... Oh! I forgot to mention... I´m the leader of a school club in here... and my friends Haruo, Hana, Coco, Nao and Hibiki are there too!

As I was saying... we are looking for a new member for our club ASAP!!! We had.... a problem and... well that doesn´t matter! We do plenty of cool stuff in here! Such as... and also... Oh and I almost forget about...! (Coco, here is where you make something up to complete the blank spaces, remember, fun, interesting, amusing etc! And also!!! DON´T FORGET TO ERASE THIS)

We´ll be really honoured to have you in our club! Remember to go to the third floor, and go straight ahead, we are behind the last door!

Well... I guess I´ve said enough... Anyway! We´ll be waiting for you at the club!

Sincerely,

Lucky7!

[From [url=https://zaiart.itch.io/lucky7-join-the-club]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
唔……我想应该就是在这里说明我们的情况了吧……

嗨，你好呀！我叫隆志！就读于彩虹丘高中！没错，就是那个传说发源地的学校；不，从我们这儿其实根本看不到什么彩虹……

言归正传！其实我现在遇到了点麻烦……和我的朋友们一起……我们大伙儿全都遇上麻烦了……你看……我们正在招募一名新社员……哦！忘了自我介绍……我是学校里某个社团的社长……我的朋友们春男、花、可可、奈绪还有响也都在社团里！

就像我刚才说的……我们火速急招一名新社员加入社团！！！我们之前出了点……小状况，不过……哎呀那些都不重要啦！我们在社团里会干好多超酷的事情哦！比如说……还有……噢我差点忘了提……！（可可，这里就交给你随便编点内容把空白填上啦，记住要写得开心、有趣、好玩一点！还有还有！！！千万别忘了把括号里这段话删掉！）

如果你能加入我们的社团，我们真的会倍感荣幸！记得上三楼一直往前走，我们就在最尽头那扇门后面！

好啦……我想我已经说得够多了……总之！我们在社团活动室等你哦！

谨上，

Lucky7！
